source: This is why embedding quality and search-system quality are separate problems. A perfect exact nearest-neighbor search over bad embeddings still returns neighbors according to the wrong geometry. Conversely, a strong embedding model can be undermined by the wrong similarity metric, stale vectors, bad chunking, or overly aggressive approximate search.
zh: 这就是为什么嵌入质量和搜索系统质量是不同的问题。对不良嵌入的完美精确最近邻搜索仍然会根据错误的几何形状返回邻居。相反，错误的相似性度量、过时的向量、错误的分块或过于激进的近似搜索可能会破坏强大的嵌入模型。
